+memcached (1.6.24-1ubuntu0.2) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * Fix out-of-bounds heap write in the LRU crawler dump path when an
+    idle client stalls reading a dump (LP: #2161693):
+    - d/p/lp2161693-0-fix-lru-crawler-buffer-overflow-on-idle-client.patch:
+      backport 7eeac6e9, retry on poll() timeout instead of a false flush.
+    - d/p/lp2161693-1-fix-lru-crawler-unlock-of-unlocked-mutex.patch:
+      backport ea35f44, lock lru_locks[i] before lru_crawler_class_done().
+
+ -- Seyeong Kim <seyeong.kim@canonical.com>  Fri, 24 Jul 2026 03:09:54 +0000
+
 memcached (1.6.24-1ubuntu0.1) noble-security; urgency=medium
 
   * SECURITY UPDATE: SASL password timing side-channel
diff --git a/debian/patches/lp2161693-0-fix-lru-crawler-buffer-overflow-on-idle-client.patch b/debian/patches/lp2161693-0-fix-lru-crawler-buffer-overflow-on-idle-client.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1cdb561
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/lp2161693-0-fix-lru-crawler-buffer-overflow-on-idle-client.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+Description: crawler: fix buffer overflow on idle client
+ memcached's LRU crawler dump path (lru_crawler_write() in crawler.c) treated a
+ poll() timeout on the client socket as a successful flush ("if (ret == 0)
+ return 0;"). When a client starts a dump (lru_crawler metadump all / mgdump)
+ and then stops reading, the kernel send buffer fills, poll() times out, and the
+ crawler thread keeps appending crawler output past the end of the fixed 128 KB
+ heap buffer -- an out-of-bounds heap write that can crash the server. Add a
+ ~30 minute backstop (1800 x 1000 ms) that retries the timed-out client and then
+ disconnects it, and move "sent += total" inside the write-success branch so a
+ persistent EAGAIN cannot underflow the unsigned counter.
+Origin: upstream, https://github.com/memcached/memcached/commit/7eeac6e9a9945aa68298aff379cea5ab3817af7c
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2161693
+Applied-Upstream: 1.6.44
+Last-Update: 2026-07-24
+Index: memcached-1.6.24/crawler.c
+===================================================================
+--- memcached-1.6.24.orig/crawler.c
++++ memcached-1.6.24/crawler.c
+@@ -347,6 +347,10 @@ static int lru_crawler_write(crawler_cli
+ 
+     if (c->c == NULL) return -1;
+     if (data_size == 0) return 0;
++    // a long backstop so clients can't hang forever.
++    // continually timed out stuff used to blow up memory and crash so this is
++    // just to avoid replacing one problem with another.
++    int tries = 1800;
+ 
+     while (sent < data_size) {
+         int ret = poll(to_poll, 1, 1000);
+@@ -356,7 +360,14 @@ static int lru_crawler_write(crawler_cli
+             return -1;
+         }
+ 
+-        if (ret == 0) return 0;
++        // Timed out, retry for a while.
++        if (ret == 0) {
++            if (--tries == 0) {
++                lru_crawler_close_client(c);
++                return -1;
++            }
++            continue;
++        }
+ 
+         // check if socket was closed on us.
+         if (to_poll[0].revents & POLLIN) {
+@@ -383,8 +394,9 @@ static int lru_crawler_write(crawler_cli
+             } else if (total == 0) {
+                 lru_crawler_close_client(c);
+                 return -1;
++            } else {
++                sent += total;
+             }
+-            sent += total;
+         }
+     } // while
+ 
diff --git a/debian/patches/lp2161693-1-fix-lru-crawler-unlock-of-unlocked-mutex.patch b/debian/patches/lp2161693-1-fix-lru-crawler-unlock-of-unlocked-mutex.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..00bcbd4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/lp2161693-1-fix-lru-crawler-unlock-of-unlocked-mutex.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+Description: crawler: fix potential unlock of unlocked mutex
+ lru_crawler_class_done() ends by unlocking lru_locks[i]; two early-fail paths in
+ item_crawler_thread() called it without holding that lock (unlock of an unlocked
+ mutex plus an unlink under no lock). This path was largely unreachable until the
+ idle-client backstop in the previous patch makes lru_crawler_write() return -1,
+ so both fixes belong together. Take lru_locks[i] before lru_crawler_class_done()
+ on those two paths.
+Origin: upstream, https://github.com/memcached/memcached/commit/ea35f441f265b4aef3f7753aa5cbb87d99859123
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/bugs/2161693
+Applied-Upstream: 1.6.44
+Last-Update: 2026-07-24
+Index: memcached-1.6.24/crawler.c
+===================================================================
+--- memcached-1.6.24.orig/crawler.c
++++ memcached-1.6.24/crawler.c
+@@ -522,11 +522,15 @@ static void *item_crawler_thread(void *a
+                 if (c->buflen - c->bufused < LRU_CRAWLER_MINBUFSPACE) {
+                     int ret = lru_crawler_write(c);
+                     if (ret != 0) {
++                        // Must be locked to unlink crawler.
++                        pthread_mutex_lock(&lru_locks[i]);
+                         lru_crawler_class_done(i);
+                         continue;
+                     }
+                 }
+             } else if (active_crawler_mod.mod->needs_client) {
++                // Must be locked to unlink crawler.
++                pthread_mutex_lock(&lru_locks[i]);
+                 lru_crawler_class_done(i);
+                 continue;
+             }
